heading: Sahel development program; planning

tree.heading: Congressional support
tree.text: The Congress reaffirms its support of the initiative of the United States Government in undertaking consultations and planning with the countries concerned, with other nations providing assistance, with the United Nations, and with other concerned international and regional organizations, toward the development and support of a comprehensive long-term African Sahel development program.

tree.heading: Presidential authorization
tree.text: The President is authorized to develop a long-term comprehensive development program for the Sahel and other drought-stricken nations in Africa.

tree.heading: Presidential guidelines
tree.text: In developing this long-term program, the President shall—

children.text: consider international coordination for the planning and implementation of such program;
seek greater participation and support by African countries and organizations in determining development priorities; and
